name: Produkte Bild
description: One row per gallery image on a Produkte record. Row order (built-in idx) is the display/slider order.

fields.label: Bild
fields.description: Canonical image-file field, spelled with both n's (bild_anhangen). This is what the live product gallery (ProdukteDetails.js) and the shop listing cards (Produkte/produkte.js) actually read — do not rename to bild_anhagen (see README 'Known frontend inconsistency' for the one file that gets this wrong).

fields.label: Image Name
fields.description: Caption/title shown in the PhotoSwipe lightbox as `title`. NOTE: the frontend reads this row as `imageName` (camelCase) — api.py re-keys image_name -> imageName in the response, don't rename this field to camelCase in Frappe.

fields.label: Alt Text Override
fields.description: Per-image `alt` text override for this row; the frontend falls back to the parent product's product_name when blank. Deliberately named produkt_name (not alt_text) to match the existing frontend contract (img.produkt_name) — this is this child row's own field, distinct from the parent Produkte doctype's product_name field, and is NOT renamed by the parent's produkt_name -> product_name rename.
